title: Output encoding (--output-encoding)
summary: Chooses the bytes verbs write to stdout, stderr and --output files: ASCII with \uXXXX escapes (default), UTF-8 or UTF-16LE, never a BOM; lossy ascii warns once
intro: Read this when a tool reads drag-lint output through a pipe and a path or message holds non-ASCII text. The default is 7-bit ASCII -- the JSON escape inside --json, so a JSON reader gets the exact string back; --output-encoding utf8|utf16 (or outputEncoding in .drag-lint.json) writes raw Unicode instead.

questions.ask: How do I get UTF-8 instead of escaped ASCII from the engine?
How do I make UTF-8 the default for every run in a folder?
Why does my output show \u00e9 instead of the character?
